distribution.summary: 福建；江西；四川；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) record Fujian and Yunnan. Smith et al. (2020) confirms Fujian/Yunnan and adds Jiangxi, Sichuan and Taiwan. Lin & Smith (2022) independently records Taiwan, confirming the existing Taiwan assessment without adding a new mainland province.

host_note: Baseline hosts Castanopsis sp., Lithocarpus sp. and Quercus sp. are retained. Smith et al. (2020) adds only a family-level Anacardiaceae host record. Lin & Smith (2022) adds no promoted host evidence for this taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion armiger (Schedl, 1953).

taxonomic_history.name: Cyclorhipidion armiger
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) use Xyleborus armiger; Smith et al. (2020) uses the current combination Cyclorhipidion armiger. Canonical authorship follows integrated taxonomic backbone: (Schedl, 1953).
